problems.reason: Sentence 4 claims Abydosaurus fossils are from the "Upper Lower Cretaceous" of northeastern Utah, while sentence 7 specifies they date to the Albian stage of the Early Cretaceous (≈104 Ma). The two statements give incompatible geological ages for the same fossils.
